Japan's tax-free shopping changes on 1 November 2026.

Before: the 10% came off at the till.
After: you pay the full price, then claim the 10% back at the airport before you fly.

Budget for the full amount up front.

What changes → gentlyyonder.com/go/tax

Before you choose a Tokyo hotel, choose the station.

First trip: Shinjuku's south or west side, or Shibuya.
Shinkansen days: Tokyo Station, Marunouchi side.
Old Tokyo, better value: Asakusa or Ueno.

Then book within five minutes of it.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo

Honest question for anyone who has been back to the same country twice:

What did you do differently the second time?

Ours: fewer cities, more nights in each, and a hotel near the station we actually used.

Japan's departure tax tripled on 1 July 2026: ¥1,000 → ¥3,000 per person.

There's no queue or machine for it at the airport. It's built into your plane or ferry ticket.

If a fare out of Japan looks a little higher than last year, this is part of why.

Where to stay in Kyoto, in one line: downtown, between Karasuma and Kawaramachi.

Two subway lines and two private railways meet there, Nishiki Market and the river are on foot, and you spend less of your trip waiting for buses.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto

Booking a DMZ tour from Seoul? Read the title twice.

The JSA at Panmunjom, with the blue huts, has been closed to civilian tours since July 2023. A "DMZ & JSA" promise can't be kept.

And check for a shopping stop before you compare prices.

gentlyyonder.com/go/dmz

Korea trip early next year? Check this in December.

Travellers from 22 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Japan, don't need a K-ETA until 31 December 2026.

No extension has been announced yet. Korea has extended it before.

gentlyyonder.com/go/keta

Tokyo to Kyoto, three ways:

Shinkansen: about 2h 15m and about ¥14,170, city centre to city centre.
Flying via Osaka: roughly twice as long, door to door.
Overnight bus: the budget option.

We'd take the train.

gentlyyonder.com/go/tokyo-kyoto

Our Sydney pick, and one of us has stayed there (paid our own way):

Sheraton Grand Sydney Hyde Park.

On the park, a couple of minutes from St James and Museum stations, with a rooftop pool and Circular Quay a few stops away.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sydney

Osaka has two centres. Pick the one that fits.

Namba and Shinsaibashi: food, nightlife, Nankai trains to the airport.
Umeda: JR to Kyoto and Kobe, and the Haruka from Kansai Airport.

The Midosuji line links them in about ten minutes.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-osaka

Flying to Singapore? File the SG Arrival Card in the three days before you land. The day you arrive counts as one of them.

It's free on ICA's own website or the MyICA app. Paid services aren't needed.

Travellers who skip it may be refused entry.

What's the one thing you packed for your last trip and never used?

And the one thing you wished you'd brought?

Kyoto's hotel tax, per person, per night, since 1 March 2026:

Under ¥6,000: ¥200
¥6,000–19,999: ¥400
¥20,000–49,999: ¥1,000
¥50,000–99,999: ¥4,000
¥100,000 and up: ¥10,000

Usually added to your bill at check-out.

Booking a Tokyo food tour? Choose the neighbourhood and the hour before the company.

Shinjuku's izakaya alleys: evening.
Tsukiji: morning.
Asakusa: old-town snacks.

Then compare the same tour on Viator and Klook. Prices differ during sales.

gentlyyonder.com/go/foodtour

First time in Melbourne? Stay inside the Free Tram Zone.

Trams in the city centre are free, the SkyBus from the airport stops at Southern Cross on its edge, and most of what you'll want is a short ride away.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-mel

Eurail is now Interrail: since 9 September 2026, one pass range for everyone.

A pass wins for long trips across several countries, loose plans, children aged 4–11 or under-28s.

On a fixed route, advance tickets are often cheaper.

gentlyyonder.com/go/eurail

Vietnam has no single best month: north, centre and south have different weather.

For a north-to-south trip, late February to April and October to November compromise least.

May to September is cheaper and greener, with afternoon rain.

gentlyyonder.com/go/vn-when

Three things get easier with Japan's tax-free shopping from 1 November:

No more sealed bags for cosmetics and snacks.
One set of rules instead of two.
No ¥500,000 cap on consumables.

The catch: you pay the 10% first and claim it back at the airport.

Going to Bali? Budget for the tourist levy: IDR 150,000 per person, paid once per trip.

Pay it only on the official Love Bali website, run by Bali's provincial government. Lookalike sites exist.

There are also payment counters at Bali's airport and port.

If you stay in Asakusa, set one alarm for 7 a.m.

At that hour the Senso-ji precinct is close to empty. By late morning it's crowded.

It's the strongest case for staying on that side of Tokyo.

Staying at Bondi in Sydney? Know the commute first.

There's no train to the beach: it's a train to Bondi Junction, then a bus.

Perfect for a swim before breakfast. Less so if most of your plans are in the city.

Taiwan's high-speed rail 3-Day Pass (NT$2,200) is the one most visitors buy, and it often loses.

Taipei–Kaohsiung and back: NT$2,980 standard, about NT$1,938 Early Bird, about NT$1,266 each on a buy-one-get-one pair.

The discounts don't stack.

gentlyyonder.com/go/thsr

First thing to buy in Hong Kong: an Octopus card, the tap-and-go card that works on almost everything.

Then cross the harbour on the Star Ferry at least once after dark. It has been running since 1888.

gentlyyonder.com/go/hk

A good-value harbour trip in Sydney: the commuter ferry to Manly.

About half an hour from Circular Quay, past the Opera House and out towards the Heads.

Stay in Manly and that's your daily ride into town.

Send this to whoever you're travelling with:

Screenshot the first night's address in the local language.
Know how you're getting from the airport.
Withdraw a little local cash on arrival.
Plan nothing big for day one.

The first-trip checklist → gentlyyonder.com/go/ft

No need for a dinner cruise to see Bangkok from the river.

The Chao Phraya Express Boat, a public commuter service, runs the same water for a normal fare. The ICONSIAM shuttle from Sathorn crosses it free.

Ride up to Tha Tien for Wat Pho.

gentlyyonder.com/go/bkk-river

Café de l'Ambre in Ginza has served coffee, and only coffee, since 1948.

Around 30 single origins, one blend, and beans aged for decades.

Order, sit, and don't hurry. That's the point.

Nine old Tokyo coffee houses → gentlyyonder.com/go/kissaten

A Europe trip across several countries? One regional eSIM usually covers it.

Check that non-EU stops such as Switzerland, the UK or the Balkans are included.

For one to two weeks of moderate use, 10–20 GB is typical.

gentlyyonder.com/go/esim-eu

One city for a week, or three cities in a week?

We know which we'd pick. We'd like to hear the case for three.

A Ha Long Bay day trip from Hanoi is mostly a bus ride.

The bay is about 200 km away and the road takes at least three hours each way: roughly six hours in a vehicle around four to eight on the water.

A night on the bay changes that sum.

gentlyyonder.com/go/halong

Day tour from Taipei?

KKday for Taroko Gorge, Sun Moon Lake, Alishan and night markets. Klook for the Jiufen–Shifen–Yehliu loop, where listings often include Yehliu entry.

Prices usually differ by under 5%, so compare what's included.

gentlyyonder.com/go/taipei-tours

Day trip to Mount Fuji from Tokyo? Where you stay matters.

Highway buses to Fuji leave from Busta Shinjuku, above Shinjuku Station's south exit.

Stay on that side and you can walk to the bus.

Unlimited-data eSIMs only pay off if you use the data.

Maps and messages? A sized plan is cheaper.
Daily video calls and streaming? Unlimited earns it.

If Holafly fits, code YONDER takes 5% off (we earn a commission).

gentlyyonder.com/go/esim

First trip to Japan? Sleep in two places, not four.

Tokyo 4 nights, then Kyoto 3: one move by Shinkansen, and Osaka and Nara become day trips.

How many nights where, and how to handle moving day:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-japan

Big suitcase on the Shinkansen?

On the Tokaido line, a bag over 160 cm (length + width + height, up to 250 cm) needs a seat with an oversized-baggage area. Reserving it is free. Without one, you pay ¥1,000.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-japan

Kyoto's hotel tax since 1 March 2026, per person per night:

under ¥6,000: ¥200
¥6,000+: ¥400
¥20,000+: ¥1,000
¥50,000+: ¥4,000
¥100,000+: ¥10,000

Osaka's tops out at ¥500.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-japan

One night in Hakone? Where you sleep decides what you ride.

Gora: the whole loop starts at your door.
Yumoto: step off the Romancecar into your hotel.
Lake Ashi: the water, and Mount Fuji on a clear day.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hakone

Hakone stays with a private open-air bath in every room:

Hakone Ginyu (20 rooms, over the gorge)
Kowakien Ten-yu (150)
Hotel Indigo Hakone Gora (100, on the balcony)
Kinnotake Sengokuhara (9, adults only)

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hakone

Travelling light in Hakone: leave your bag at the luggage counter in Hakone-Yumoto Station by noon, and it reaches your hotel from 15:00.

¥1,500 a bag, ¥2,500 for a large case.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hakone

Lotte Hotel Seoul is now The Grand Lotte Seoul.

It reopened in August 2026 after about 15 months of room renovation, going from 1,015 rooms to 868. Some booking sites still show the old name.

Where to stay in Seoul, with 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-seoul

First trip to Seoul? Stay in Myeongdong or around City Hall.

Jongno and Insadong: the palaces on foot.
Hongdae: nightlife and the airport train.
Gangnam: only if your plans are south of the river.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-seoul

Incheon Airport to central Seoul: the AREX express runs non-stop to Seoul Station in about 43 minutes from Terminal 1, for ₩13,000.

Flying out early? One hotel is linked to the station by an underground passage:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-seoul

First trip to Bangkok? Stay on Sukhumvit, between Nana and Phrom Phong.

Siam: the centre of the Skytrain.
Riverside: the grand hotels and boats to the temples.
Old Town: the Grand Palace on foot.

Five areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-bangkok

The Dusit Thani Bangkok closed in January 2019 and was rebuilt from the ground up. The new hotel opened on 27 September 2024, with 257 rooms, all facing Lumphini Park.

Booking sites still list the old one too:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-bangkok

Thai hotel price ends in "++"? That is a 10% service charge, then 7% VAT on top: about 17.7% more.

Compare totals, not headline rates. Where to stay in Bangkok:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-bangkok

In an August survey for Greetwell, a travel concierge firm, 55% of US travellers who planned with AI got at least one bad recommendation, and 1 in 6 were sent to a place, tour or activity that doesn't exist.

AI is a fine first draft. Check anything you pay for.

Two things we caught this week in our own guides:

Hong Kong's trams cost HK$3.30, not HK$3.
Japan's departure tax has been ¥3,000 since 1 July; one of our summaries still said ¥1,000.

Both fixed, both logged in public:
gentlyyonder.com/corrections.html

When AI gets a trip wrong, it's rarely dramatic. In Greetwell's August survey of US travellers using AI, 27% got wrong prices, hours or details, and 10% were sent to a business that had closed down.

Every fix we make is logged in public:
gentlyyonder.com/corrections.html

First trip to Hong Kong? Stay in Tsim Sha Tsui, near the Star Ferry.

Central: the Airport Express and the Peak Tram.
Causeway Bay: shopping and the trams.
Mong Kok: markets and lower prices.

Five areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hong-kong

Hong Kong brought back its hotel tax on 1 January 2025: 3% of the room charge.

With the usual 10% service charge, a bill runs about 13% over the room rate.

Compare totals, not headline prices:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hong-kong

The free Airport Express shuttle buses to most Hong Kong hotels are gone. A few hotels now run their own from the stations, and MTR lists them.

Check yours before you land, or plan on a taxi or the MTR.

Where to stay:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-hong-kong

Kyoto's cherry trees usually reach full bloom on 4 April. In 2026 they were full by 30 March.

So don't bet on one weekend: book a refundable room across the end of March and the start of April, and adjust when the forecasts come out.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-sakura

Kyoto's accommodation tax since 1 March 2026, per person per night:

Under ¥6,000: ¥200
¥6,000+: ¥400
¥20,000+: ¥1,000
¥50,000+: ¥4,000
¥100,000+: ¥10,000

Blossom-season rates can push a room up a band.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-sakura

For Kyoto's cherry blossom, sleep in Okazaki.

The Philosopher's Path: about 2 km under some 400 cherry trees.
The Keage Incline: 582 m, about 90 more.
Both on foot, and the subway downtown.

Five areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-sakura

First trip to Singapore? Stay around Marina Bay and the Civic District.

The river: evenings by the water.
Orchard Road: shopping.
Chinatown: hawker food.
Sentosa: beaches, with children.

Five areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-singapore

Singapore hotel price ends in "++"? That is a 10% service charge, then 9% GST on top of it: about 19.9% more.

Hotels may show prices before GST, so compare totals, not headline rates.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-singapore

Booking Hilton Singapore Orchard? It is the former Mandarin Orchard, reopened as a Hilton in February 2022 with 1,080 rooms, the brand's largest in Asia Pacific.

Where to stay in Singapore:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-singapore

First trip to Taipei? Stay around Taipei Main Station or Zhongshan.

Ximending: food and value.
Xinyi: Taipei 101.
Da'an: cafés and quieter streets.
Beitou: a night in a hot-spring room.

Five areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-taipei

Flying to Taiwan? The paper arrival card is gone.

Since 1 October 2025 it is the online Taiwan Arrival Card: free, filled in on the National Immigration Agency's site in the week before you arrive.

Where to stay in Taipei:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-taipei

A night in Beitou, Taipei's hot-spring district: Red Line to Beitou, then the one-stop branch to Xinbeitou.

The 1913 public bathhouse is now a free museum, and some hotels pipe spring water to a bath in every room.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-taipei

First trip to Kuala Lumpur? Stay in KLCC, by the Petronas Towers.

Bukit Bintang: food and shopping.
The old city: Merdeka Square and Chinatown.
KL Sentral: 28 minutes to the airport.

Four areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kuala-lumpur

Booking a hotel in Malaysia? Foreign guests pay a tourism tax of RM10 per room per night, on top of the 8% service tax, and many hotels add a service charge.

Compare totals, not headline rates:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kuala-lumpur

Kuala Lumpur's newest hotel is 75 floors up: Park Hyatt opened on 7 August 2025 on levels 75 to 114 of Merdeka 118, with a spa on the 99th floor.

Where to stay in KL:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kuala-lumpur

Going to Tokyo for the cherry blossom in 2027? The usual full-bloom date is 31 March; in 2026 it came on 28 March.

Book a refundable room for the last ten days of March, and stay four or five nights, not two.

Areas and hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-sakura

Tokyo's hotel tax changes on 1 April 2027: from ¥100 or ¥200 a person a night to 3% of the room charge, on rooms of ¥13,000 or more per person.

A ¥40,000-a-person night: ¥200 now, ¥1,200 after.

Where to stay for the blossom:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-sakura

Shinjuku Gyoen has about 900 cherry trees of some 70 varieties, from early kinds in February to double-flowered ones in mid-April. Adult entry is ¥500, and alcohol isn't allowed.

Where to stay for Tokyo's blossom:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-sakura

Sydney New Year's Eve 2026: fireworks at 9pm and midnight, and Circular Quay Station closes from 3pm to midnight.

Walk in from Wynyard, Martin Place or St James instead.

Where to stay for the fireworks:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sydney-nye

Booking Sydney for New Year's Eve? Check the minimum stay first.

YHA Sydney Harbour takes NYE bookings for 7 nights or more, and Shangri-La Sydney's NYE offer says a minimum stay applies.

Four areas, 12 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sydney-nye

Most free vantage points for Sydney's New Year's Eve fireworks are alcohol-free in 2026, and most don't let you back in once you leave.

Darling Harbour has its own fireworks at 9pm and midnight.

Where to stay:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sydney-nye

The 2027 Sapporo Snow Festival runs from 4 to 11 February, at Odori (lit until 10pm), Susukino (until 11pm) and Tsudome (10am to 4pm).

The dates are fixed, so you can book now.

Where to stay, by site:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sapporo-snow

Sapporo has a hotel tax now. Since 1 April 2026, Sapporo and Hokkaido together charge ¥300 a person a night under ¥20,000, ¥400 from ¥20,000 and ¥1,000 from ¥50,000.

It applies even if you booked earlier.

gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sapporo-snow

Sapporo Park Hotel, open by Nakajima Park since 1964, closes on 28 February 2027 to be rebuilt. The 2027 Snow Festival will be its last in this building.

Where to stay for the festival:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-sapporo-snow

Niseko's 2026/27 season starts on 28 November. An adult day on the All Mountain Pass is ¥13,500 in peak season (24 Dec to 28 Feb) and ¥12,600 in the regular season.

Where to stay, resort by resort:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-niseko

Niseko's hotels now carry a 3% tax: Kutchan (Hirafu, HANAZONO) since 1 April 2026, and Niseko Town (Niseko Village, Annupuri) for stays from 1 November 2026.

Budget it into the room price:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-niseko

Skiing Niseko on a budget? Kutchan town, below the resorts, has the JR station, supermarkets and cheaper beds, about 15 minutes' drive from the Hirafu lifts.

Ten hotels, from ski-in to pods:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-niseko

Fukuoka's airport is 5 minutes from Hakata Station by subway, for ¥260. So where you stay depends on what you came for: the trains, the yatai, the shops or the sea.

Four areas, 11 hotels:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-fukuoka

Staying in Fukuoka by 15 December? Overseas visitors can use the Kyushu recovery discount: 50% off, up to ¥20,000 a person a trip. It works on Japanese booking sites and direct with registered hotels, not on Booking.com.

The rules:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-fukuoka

Fukuoka's yatai gather in three areas: Nakasu, Tenjin and Nagahama. Hotel Il Palazzo, Aldo Rossi's first building in Japan, puts the Nakasu stalls a minute's walk away.

Where to stay for them:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-fukuoka

Kyoto's maples turn late, and lately later: the observatory's sample tree turned fully red on 10 December in 2025, and on 20 December in 2024, the latest on record. Aim for the last ten days of November.

Where to stay:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-autumn

Eikan-do in 2026: the autumn opening runs 11 November to 6 December, at a new price of ¥1,500, and the light-up 20 November to 6 December, ¥1,000. Tickets are sold on the day only.

Stay within a walk of it:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-autumn

Tofuku-ji's Tsuten-kyo bridge costs ¥1,000 from 14 November to 6 December, against ¥600 the rest of the year, and opens at 8.30am. It is one stop from Kyoto Station on the JR Nara line.

Hotels near it:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-kyoto-autumn

Busan's 21st Fireworks Festival is on Saturday 7 November 2026, over Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaek Island. A hotel room facing Gwangan Bridge is the seat you do not have to queue for.

Where to stay:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-busan

From Gimhae Airport to Haeundae: the limousine leaves platform 3, about hourly from 7.10am to 9.40pm, for ₩9,500, and takes credit cards only. To Seomyeon it is ₩6,000.

Where to stay at either end:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-busan

Staying in a Korean hotel? Foreign tourists travelling independently can claim back the VAT on room charges, for up to 30 nights, at hotels designated for the scheme. Ask the hotel when you book.

Our Busan guide:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-busan

Tokyo's leaves turn late: by the weather agency's normals, the ginkgo turns yellow on 23 November and the maples red on 28 November. In 2024 both waited until 3 December. Aim for the last week of November.

Where to stay:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-autumn

Rikugien's autumn evening opening runs from 25 November to 6 December 2026, 6pm to 8.30pm. Tickets are ¥1,000 online in advance or ¥1,200 on the day, and each day's numbers are limited.

Stay near it:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-autumn

Going to Shinjuku Gyoen in late November? From 16 November it closes on Mondays again, and from October it shuts at 4.30pm, last entry 4pm. Adults pay ¥500, by IC card at the gate.

Hotels by the garden:
gentlyyonder.com/go/stay-tokyo-autumn
